name: better-prompt
description: Sharpens weak prompts, tracks topic drift, and shows context, 5h and 7d usage with an animated pixel crab.

promptAssist.title: Prompt assist
promptAssist.description: Judge each prompt before it is sent: rewrite weak ones (blocking the send until you confirm) and flag topic changes. Off leaves prompts untouched; the context band stays. Toggle in session with /bp on|off.

model.title: Judge model
model.description: Model that judges and rewrites prompts (a cheap one is enough).

autoRewrite.title: Rewrite weak prompts
autoRewrite.description: With prompt assist on: put an improved version in the prompt box instead of sending a weak prompt. Off keeps only the topic-change advice.

sizeWarnPercent.title: Context warning %
sizeWarnPercent.description: Suggest /compact when the context window is this full.

gaugeWarnPercent.title: Gauge threshold %
gaugeWarnPercent.description: Where the context gauge marks its limit (10-95). Only colours the gauge; the /compact suggestion stays on the setting above.

divergeWarnPercent.title: Divergence threshold %
divergeWarnPercent.description: Where the divergence meter turns amber/red and the 'chat is diverging' suggestion appears (10-95).
